senses.gloss:
भुक्त p. p. [भुज्-कर्मणि क्त]
1 Eaten.
--2 Enjoyed, used.
--3 Suffered,
experienced.
--4 Possessed, occupied
(in law).
--5 Passed (as time).
--क्तं
1 The act of eating or enjoying.
--2
That which is eaten, food.
--3 The
[]
place where any one has eaten.
--Comp.
--उच्छिष्टं, --शेषः, --समुज्झितं
remnants of the food eaten, leavings
of food, orts.
--भोग a. {1} one who
has enjoyed or suffered (anything).
{2} that which has been used,
enjoyed, or employed.
--वृद्धिः f. the
swelling of food (in the stomach).
--सुप्त
a. sleeping after a meal.

भुक्तिः f. [भुज्-क्तिन्]
1 Eating,
enjoyment.
--2 (In law)
Possession, fruition; Pt. 3. 94; Y. 2. 22.
--3 Food.
--4 The daily motion of a
planet.
--5 A limit.
--Comp.
--प्रदः a
kind of plant (मुद्ग).
--वर्जित a. not
allowed to be enjoyed.

भूकः --कं
1 A cavity, hole, chasm.
--2 The spring.
--3 Time.
--कः
Darkness.
